title: Three-Hour Meditation With SRF/YSS President Brother Chidananda | 2026 SRF World Convocation
formattedMarkdown:
# Three-Hour Meditation With SRF/YSS President Brother Chidananda

### Opening Invocation

"Heavenly Father, Divine Mother, Friend, Beloved God, Jesus Christ, Bhagavan Krishna, Mahavatar Babaji, Lahiri Mahasaya, Swami Sri Yukteswar, Paramahansa Yogananda, saints of all religions, we bow to you all. Bless us that we may sit in the stillness of our souls, that the restlessness of the world may fade away, and we may feel the presence of the Divine within."

### The Path of Inner Stillness

Brother Chidananda began by reminding the devotees that the purpose of the three-hour meditation is not merely to endure the time, but to surrender the ego. "True meditation," he noted, "is the art of dying before you die—the systematic withdrawal of life force from the senses back into the source, the spinal center."

**Story • The Ocean and the Wave**

Story: A young seeker once asked his guru why he could not feel the presence of God despite years of practice. The guru pointed to the ocean. "Look at these waves," he said. "Each wave is different in height, force, and appearance, yet beneath every ripple, there is only one substance: the water. You are the wave, so worried about your form, your boundaries, and your movement, that you have forgotten you are the ocean. Meditation is simply the act of flattening the ripples of the mind so that the wave realizes it never existed apart from the vast, eternal sea of Spirit."

### Guided Meditation Segments

*   **Phase 1: Energization and Relaxation:** Brother Chidananda led the congregation through the systematic tensing and relaxing of the body to withdraw prana. He emphasized, "The body is the temple, but do not mistake the temple for the Deity residing within."
*   **Phase 2: The Hong-Sau Technique:** Focus was directed to the breath, using the mantra 'Hong' on the inhalation and 'Sau' on the exhalation. He cautioned against mechanical repetition, urging the heart to seek the Divine.
*   **Phase 3: The Aum Technique:** As the meditation deepened, the focus moved to the inner sound of Aum, the cosmic vibration that sustains all creation.

### The Importance of Consistency

"Many ask, 'How do I maintain this peace when I return to my office or my home?'" Brother Chidananda explained. "You maintain it by carrying the stillness like a precious pearl in your heart. Do not let the world touch the pearl. When you feel anger rising, remember the breath. When you feel anxiety, remember the spine. You are never separate from the source."

### Closing Blessing

"May the light of God shine upon you. May the peace of the Infinite dwell in your heart. May the love of the Masters be the guiding star of your life. Om, Peace, Peace, Peace."
